info.title: Zupflow API
info.description: Generated from @zupflow/contract. Every response is an envelope `{ data, meta, error }`; IDs are prefixed, opaque strings.

consoleSession.description: A Console session. Workspace routes also need the `organization` header.

organization.name: Zupflow-Organization
organization.description: The organization a Console call acts in (`org_…`). Required with a Console session on workspace routes; 400 `organization_required` without it.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Makes a retry safe: 1–255 printable ASCII characters, scoped to the caller that sent it, kept for 24 hours. The same key and request replays the saved response; the same key with a different request answers `422 idempotency_key_reused`; a key still in flight answers `409 idempotency_request_in_progress`; a malformed key answers `400 invalid_idempotency_key`. Routes marked `x-zupflow-shows-secret-once` never save their body: a retry answers `409 idempotency_key_completed`.

Error.description: An error: branch on `error.code`, never on `error.message`.

input_tokens.description: Every token the model read, those read from or written to the provider's prompt cache included.

cache_read_input_tokens.description: The part of `input_tokens` the provider served from its prompt cache.

cache_write_input_tokens.description: The part of `input_tokens` the provider wrote to its prompt cache. Providers that cache on their own report none.

get.summary: How the Console signs in: `local`, or `oidc` with the issuer and client ID
The signed-in member and their organizations

The signed-in person's own invitations, pending and expired, newest first: at most `INVITATION_LIST_LIMIT` (50), leaving out any expired more than `EXPIRED_INVITATION_SHOWN_DAYS` (30) days ago. `403 email_unverified` when the sign-in doesn't vouch for the user's address now (backend only: the mock doesn't simulate verification)

post.summary: Join the invitation's organization with the invited role. Someone else's invitation, or one withdrawn (by an admin, or because its grantor can't grant it any more) or declined, is `404`; an accepted one `409 invitation_accepted`; an expired one `422 invitation_expired`; `403 email_unverified` as for the list (backend only)

parameters.name: invitation
parameters.description: A malformed ID, or an ID of another type, answers 404 like a missing one.

post.summary: Decline an invitation, expired or not: it's withdrawn. Someone else's, or one already gone, is `404`; an accepted one `409 invitation_accepted`; `403 email_unverified` as for the list (backend only)

post.summary: Roll an endpoint's signing secret, returning the new secret once. Owners, admins and an API key for the endpoint's environment may roll, including disabled endpoints and Production. The previous secret remains valid for 24 hours; deliveries carry signatures for both secrets over the same timestamp and body until then. previous_signing_secret_expires_at is null at or after the deadline. A second roll during overlap is `409 rotation_in_progress`, even with a fresh idempotency key. Replaying a successful key is `409 idempotency_key_completed` and never returns the secret again. A missing or foreign endpoint is `404`. Records webhook.secret_rolled against the existing webhook endpoint, with no workspace and the endpoint's environment.

parameters.name: org
parameters.description: A malformed ID, or an ID of another type, answers 404 like a missing one.

post.summary: Queue a new pending delivery of the original event, preserving its ID and body and leaving the source history unchanged. Owners, admins and an API key for the endpoint's environment may resend, including in Production. The new delivery starts with zero attempts and the normal retry budget. A pending source (including an in-flight send) is `409 delivery_pending`, a disabled endpoint `409 webhook_disabled`, and one no longer subscribed `409 webhook_not_subscribed`; webhook.test is exempt from subscriptions. A missing, foreign or wrong-endpoint delivery is `404`. Normal POST idempotency applies. Records webhook.delivery_resent against the new webhook_delivery, attributed to the event's workspace and environment.

post.summary: Where a provider delivers one app's events. Slack signs each request (`X-Slack-Signature`, `X-Slack-Request-Timestamp`) with the app's signing secret: an unknown reference, a bad signature or a timestamp more than five minutes off is `401`, before anything is stored. A delivery seen before (by its event ID) is answered again without effect. Not idempotency-keyed: the provider's event ID is the key

schema.description: The app's inbound reference: 32 random characters, set when the app is made. Not an ID.
